evidence.captured_text: We use cookies to improve your experience. Manage cookie preferences: essential, analytics, marketing.

findings.narrative: Ordinary UI copy (a cookie-consent banner) mentions the bare word 'cookie' and a colon-separated 'preferences:' label, but carries no literal case-insensitive 'Cookie:'/'Set-Cookie:' HTTP-header-shaped prefix — the shape-qualified pattern (F166/F167, CR4-M4) MUST NOT redact this text; it must survive to disk byte-for-byte unmodified (negative control).
